description: Read native and Slack-synchronised conversation blocks for a finding. Each block paginates independently. API keys have no personal read or unread state.

before.description: Only messages before this timestamp, in the API's stored timestamp units.

findingId.description: Raw internal finding ID, useful when chaining from another tool.

identifier.description: Human-readable finding identifier such as "ODI-12". Preferred input.
